body:
# Chaotic Chemist 🟡🟡
**Once a cleric, you have taken your research into potions far beyond any other, leaving you with a singular mastery over their creation. However, getting to this point has left you with some issues...**

This origin does require the Create mod.

<details>
<summary>🟢 Immunity Shot [Primary]</summary>

_Inject yourself with an elixir that blocks all potion effects (including harming) being applied to you for 5 seconds._
- Primary ability
- When active you will have effects arround you
- 30 second cooldown

</details>

<details>
<summary>🟢 Chemical Engineering</summary>

_Through your research you have found a way to make your tipped arrows leave a lingering effect cloud matching the arrow type._
- Any tipped arrow will have a lingering effect cloud when it lands on a block.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🟢 Chemical Craftsman</summary>

_You can dip eight arrows into a splash potion to make eight matching tipped arrows._
- Right click 8+ arrows on a splash potion to consume the splash potion and apply the effect onto the arrows.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🟢 The Benefit of Hindsight</summary>

_You've dropped the flask on yourself before. Never again. You throw potions much farther_
- Splash and lingering potions are thrown farther

</details>

<details>
<summary>🟢 Brewmaster [Create]</summary>

_You can mix powdered obsidian, wheat flour, and cinder flour into potions to improve their potency, duration, or drink speed._
- Right click Wheat Flour/Cinder Flour/Powdered Obsidian to add it to any potion.
- Wheat Flour and Powdered Obsidian are exclusive from each other.
  - Wheat Flour: +30 duration
  - Cinder Flour: Instant drink/Bigger splash area
  - Powdered Obsidian: +1 potion strength

</details>

<details>
<summary>🟡 Mechanical Chemistry [Create]</summary>

_you can combine 2 or more potions into one but for every added effect you lose 25% duration. This can be done with a mixer and basin with the potions and water inside. This will only make one potion and leave the extra bottles empty_
- Add a bottle of water to a basin + any amount of bottled potion.
- Sneak + Right Click the mixer to combine all potions into one Mixed Potion, the duration of each potion is `(1−0.75^n)×100%` of the original, where `n` is the amount of potions-1.
- Mixed Potions will not work with Brewmaster.
- The basin will not accept potions made using Brewmaster.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🔴 Fruit Rejection</summary>

_Your body has been so altered by chemical experimentation that it no longer tolerates natural fruit. You are unable to consume fruit-based foods._
- You can no longer eat fruits.

</details>

<details>
<summary>🔴 Weak Arms</summary>

_All your time in the lab hasn't left you much for the gym. You take 50% more melee damage, deal 50% less, and cannot lift a shield._

</details>

<details>
<summary>🔴 Frail</summary>

_Your misadventures with various chemicals has left you with only 8 hearts_

</details>

<details>
<summary>🔴 Villager Spite</summary>

_Your less than successful first experiments have left you alienated from the villagers, they will not trade with you._

</details>
